create_ConstantGeometryProvider: create a ConstantGeometryProvider that returns the same Geometry for all time steps
create_TimeDependentGeometryProvider: create a TimeDependentGeometryProvider from a mapping of times to Geometry instances with interpolation
build_TimeDependentGeometryProvider_from: build a TimeDependentGeometryProvider using create_provider from a dict of time-to-geometry mappings
call_GeometryProvider: call a GeometryProvider with a time value to retrieve the Geometry for that time step
access_torax_mesh: access the torax_mesh property of a GeometryProvider to get the consistent simulation mesh
